title: [narrowed from route-edit-8ff43940] In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/gap-to-feature.ts, let a gap acquire a lan
description:
[narrowed from route-edit-8ff43940] In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/gap-to-feature.ts, let a gap acquire a land signal when its fix landed under a SIBLING gap's commit, instead of only when the commit message names the gap itself.

MEASURED DEFECT. Closure needs both a predicate and classification_metadata.pending_outcome_verification. That stamp is minted by cutover paths for the gap being composed, so a gap fixed incidentally - by the route-edit child that actually did the work - never gets one. Of 16 open gaps whose fix commits pass three independent checks (exact ancestry via git merge-base --is-ancestor, the commit touching the gap's own edit_site, and a distinctive added line still present at HEAD), only 3 had any commit naming the gap id. The other 13 had to be stamped by an operator by hand. landedCommitVerdict at ~line 2283 greps git log --grep <gapId> --fixed-strings --since=14.days; the 14-day window is NOT the binding constraint, since the unwindowed count is also 3.

THE CHANGE: when a gap has a predicate but no pending_outcome_verification, derive a candidate sha from commits that BOTH touch the gap's edit_site AND whose message names a gap in this gap's own lineage - walk the source_gap_id and parent_gap_id chain, which covers 600 of 601 lane children, with a depth bound around 8 and a visited set for cycles. Stamp the candidate and let the existing sweep adjudicate it. Name the helper landedCommitViaLineage.

This is safe precisely because the sweep re-checks independently: shaIsAncestorOfAnyClone, then shaWasRevertedInAnyClone, then verifyGapConditionAsync, closing only on a measured 'absent'. A wrong candidate is refused rather than mis-closed, which is why proposing candidates is acceptable and why the predicate must remain the gate.

DO NOT accept a commit that merely touches the edit_site with no lineage link - an unrelated commit to a hot file would manufacture a false land.
DO NOT close the gap from this code path. Only stamp; closure belongs to sweepPendingLandVerifications.

REUSE THESE EXISTING SYMBOLS — the last attempt failed with typecheck_dangling_reference, whose lesson is that a symbol you USE must be DECLARED in the same plan. Everything needed already exists in this file; do not invent helpers:
  - the lineage step is already written at line 169: `const parentId = String(meta.parent_gap_id ?? meta.source_gap_id ?? "");` — use exactly that idiom to walk upward.
  - there is already a lineage walk over the candidate set near line 3270 (its comment reads "Index the candidate set once so the backoff can walk parent_gap_id / source_gap_id"); follow its shape rather than writing a new traversal.
  - `gapEditSite(gap, meta)` at line 302 returns the gap's edit_site — use it, do not re-derive the path.
  - `shaIsAncestorOfAnyClone(sha)` at 2186 and `shaWasRevertedInAnyClone(sha)` at 2219 already exist for validating a candidate sha.
  - `vesselsCloneRoot()` at 2183 and the `git -C <clone> log` invocation inside `landedCommitVerdict` at 2283 show exactly how to shell git in this file.

SCOPE: add ONE function named landedCommitViaLineage and call it where a gap has a predicate but no pending_outcome_verification. Do not modify landedCommitVerdict itself — it is the RELAND detector and serves a different purpose.
BOUND THE WALK: depth limit around 8 with a visited set, so a cyclic parent chain cannot loop.
